entities.summary: Henry Pottinger, a notable figure in the history of Hong Kong, associated with Victorian Colonial Hong Kong (1842–1860). Preceded by Crown Colony Establishment. Their legacy influenced Convention of Peking — New Territories leased to Britain for 99 years until 1997 and Alexandre Yersin identifies the plague bacillus in Hong Kong during the epidemic.
